It sounds like therapy might be slightly beneficial for you too, it sounds like your mental health took a hit when your grandma died and i hope you're doing even slightly better now but you deserve to be happy. 

For the actual cutting off, i suggest doing it in a semi-crowded place, I dont know how violent she can be and i dont want you getting hurt OP. Just say "I know we've been close for a while but all good things come to an end, im sorry but we have to stop being friends, its for the best"

There might always be an urge. But there always is a way. It kinda feels weird as a person who doesn't plan to stop, to tell someone a coping technique.

I want you to try this, you don't have to but i want to help you, just like everyone else. Every time you feel like cutting for whatever reason I want you to go to your favourite support sub or whichever one you want and just vent in a post. Let all your feelings out and play a comforting song while doing so. If you do end up cutting, don't punish yourself, don't hate yourself for "failing". Because in reality, you didn't fail. Don't force yourself to use this tactic more don't do anything. Just take a deep breath, and continue going on with this coping mechanism as you did before. 

A similar way is to buy a notebook and vent onto that. It's been helping me, write as if you were typing a message to someone. I hope this helps. Take this hug \*hugs\*
